blockers.description: Isolation guard hook blocks Agent dispatch when the sentinel plan id mismatches the description or the sentinel is stale (>10 min).
blockers.workaround: Re-record sentinel immediately before each dispatch: gsd_run query dispatch-isolation --raw --phase "52.1" --plan "52.1-0N" --force-isolation none; use description "Execute plan 52.1-0N of phase 52.1".

decisions.decision: ISOLATION=none (base-check #683 degrade: HEAD b941994a diverged from origin/HEAD) — all 7 plans run sequentially on the main tree
decisions.rationale: Worktree fork base diverged; degrade is intended behavior per project memory

decisions.decision: Blend/interpolation path uses sync canvasToWebpBytes (toDataURL('image/webp')+atob) instead of async Rust encoder
decisions.rationale: The store's regeneration API is fully synchronous; async ripple would touch the entire store mutation API. Documented deviation.

decisions.decision: Document-sync backgroundSources carry base64 at the JSON persistence boundary (encodeSourceBytesForDocumentSync in src/lib/physicPaintBridge.ts)
decisions.rationale: JSON events cannot carry raw bytes compactly; the frame apply path itself uses raw invoke. Documented deviation.

decisions.decision: Persisted script thumbnail (PersistedRotoScriptThumbnailV1.dataUrl) keeps base64 dataUrl — disk persistence format, not the runtime frame path
decisions.rationale: Out of plan scope; JSON persistence format

decisions.decision: Legacy pre-G-52-6 revision acceptance deleted from physicsPaintRotoPhysicalModel.ts

decisions.decision: Canonical intent serialization carries bytes as base64 (canonicalPhysicalEditPayload in types/physicPaint.ts); validator accepts both Uint8Array and canonical base64 forms
decisions.rationale: JSON.stringify turns Uint8Array into an index object; the canonical form must round-trip through JSON for action transaction records

decisions.decision: Rust canonical_physical_hash retargeted to bytes token (canonical_bytes_payload: d<len>:<head-64-hex>:<tail-64-hex>;) matching JS buildFrameBytesToken
decisions.rationale: The JS/Rust hash parity pin must hold; serde serializes Vec<u8> as a JSON number array

decisions.decision: Rust thumbnail command retargeted to raw bytes (rgba: Vec<u8> in, bytes: Vec<u8> out) — no base64 in JS
decisions.rationale: D-07 no-base64-in-JS; the thumbnail request previously required rgbaBase64

decisions.decision: testWebpBytes helper created at app/src/testUtils/testWebpBytes.ts (valid WebP RIFF/VP8L magic + seed bytes)
